title: Effectiveness of pterygoid dental implants in the complete arch rehabilitation of the edentulous maxilla: a systematic review and meta-analysis
html: The aim of this systematic review was to determine the clinical effectiveness of pterygoid dental implants in the rehabilitation of the atrophic maxilla. Database searches were performed up to April 2026 to identify randomized, non-randomized, and observational human studies comparing pterygoid implants to conventional implants for full maxillary rehabilitation. Outcomes were implant survival and marginal bone loss (MBL). The meta-analysis was conducted using RevMan 5.4. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale.
